newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin seen taken to Moscow heart hospital.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin seen taken to Moscow heart hospital.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin was taken from his sanitorium at Barvikha early on Tuesday to the Moscow hospital where his heart surgery was due to take place, Reuters television cameramen and photographers reported.
They saw Yeltsin's Mercedes limousine accompanied by several jeeps with guards sweeping into the Cardiology Research Centre where security had been stepped up since Monday.
Russian doctor Renat Akchurin, who the Kremlin said on Monday would carry out the operation at the Centre, also left his home early but declined to comment.

A council of doctors, including U.S. surgeon Michael DeBakey, who is due to consult the operating team, met at Barvikha on Monday and gave the green light for Yeltsin's triple or quadruple bypass surgery.

Neither the doctors nor the Kremlin have given an exact day or time for the operation, saying only it was possible in the next few days. Ekho Moskvy radio station said the operation would take place on Tuesday.
